about_the_game:
About this Game

In the year 20XX, you are an astronaut living aboard a massive space battleship.

Recently, unexplained anomalies have begun occurring on the ship, such as objects appearing or moving without warning. Unfortunately, one of these strange events resulted in an injury to your leg.

Today, the entire crew has assembled an expedition team to explore a nearby asteroid and has departed. The Commander assigns the crucial task to you, the injured astronaut: to stay onboard, investigate the anomalies, and report back.

With everyone gone, you sit alone in the security room, staring at the CCTV monitors. In the deep silence of the enormous vessel, you will now witness the bizarre phenomena unfolding before your eyes.

Your mission is simple: Do not miss a single change in the stream of CCTV feeds and report it immediately. Only your sharp observation skills can reveal the truth in this darkness.

Key Game Features

1. Real-Time Surveillance and Reporting Mechanics

Observation Duty: Your shift runs from midnight until 03:00 A.M. During this time, you must constantly cycle through and monitor the CCTV feeds covering over a dozen different sectors.

Anomaly Detection: You must spot every anomaly, ranging from minute environmental changes—such as shifts in an object's location, count, or color—to bizarre phenomena that defy the laws of physics or the movement of entities that should not be there.

Swift Response: When you discover a change, you must immediately submit a report specifying the location, the object involved, and the type of anomaly. If the report is delayed or incorrect, the anomalies will intensify beyond control, resulting in the failure of your mission.

2. Escalating Tension and Survival

Race Against Time: As the shift progresses, the frequency and complexity of the anomalies increase, often leading to multiple events stacking up in different areas simultaneously.

Survival Threat: Failing to report certain critical anomalies (such as an intruder or an unidentified entity) in time may cause the threat to spread to the control room, leading directly to a Game Over.
